title: Newmark Expands Retail Capital Markets Business with Hiring of Bryan Belk

body_markdown:
**November 19, 2026, 2:00 PM**


Newmark announces[Bryan Belk](https://www.nmrk.com/people/bryan-belk) has joined the firm as Senior Managing Director in Atlanta. In his role, Belk will focus on institutional[retail](https://www.nmrk.com/services/capital-markets/retail-capital-markets)[investment sales](https://www.nmrk.com/services/capital-markets/investment-sales) and[capital markets](https://www.nmrk.com/services/capital-markets) throughout the Southeast region, working closely with President and Head of Retail Capital Markets[Conor Lalor](https://www.nmrk.com/people/conor-lalor) .


“Retail capital markets continue to benefit from strong sector fundamentals and growing investor demand, particularly across high-growth Sun Belt markets,” said Lalor. “Bryan brings a combination of regional market expertise, institutional relationships and transaction experience that will further strengthen our ability to serve clients throughout the Southeast. His reputation in the industry and collaborative approach make him an excellent fit for our growing retail capital markets business.”


Belk has been involved in more than 700 retail property transactions across the region, totaling more than $3 billion in sales volume. Throughout his career, he has earned numerous industry recognitions, including multiple achievement awards from previous employer Franklin Street and recognition by GlobeSt as a Top 50 Under 40 and Top Retail Influencer. He is also an active member of the International Council of Shopping Centers (ICSC), Young Atlanta Retail Alliance (YARA) and the Association of Young Real Estate Professionals (AYREP).


“Newmark has built one of the industry’s premier capital markets teams,” said Belk. “The firm’s collaborative culture, national reach and commitment to client service create a tremendous opportunity to continue growing our business throughout the Southeast and beyond.”


According to Newmark Research, U.S. retail investment sales volume reached $48 billion year-to-date through the third quarter of 2026, up 10% year-over-year and 22% above pre-pandemic averages. Retail fundamentals have remained among the strongest across major property sectors, supported by limited new supply, healthy tenant demand and sustained investor interest


**About Newmark**


Newmark Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: NMRK), together with its subsidiaries (“Newmark”), is a world leading commercial real estate advisor and service provider to large institutional investors and other owners, global corporations and other occupiers, and lenders. Built with purpose and driven by excellence, Newmark’s comprehensive platform is uniquely tailored to provide superior outcomes to clients. For the twelve months ended September 30, 2026, Newmark generated revenues of over $3.7 billion. As of September 30, 2026, Newmark and its business partners together operated from approximately 200 offices with 10,500 professionals across four continents. Learn more at[nmrk.com](https://www.nmrk.com/) or follow[@newmark](https://twitter.com/newmark) .
